glosses.notes: Usually describes producing electric power from water, wind, sunlight, or other energy sources.

examples.sentence: 这几年很多地方开始用风力和太阳能发电，希望工厂和居民晚上都能稳定用电。
山里的雨下得特别大时，这座水库不但能挡住大水，还能发电，给下面几个县城提供平时用的电。
研究人员想把工厂出来的热也拿来发电，如果试验成功，车站和商场每年都能省很多电费。

example_translations.translation: In recent years many places have started generating electricity with wind and solar power, hoping factories and residents can all have stable electricity at night.
When the rain in the mountains gets especially heavy, this reservoir can do more than block floodwater. It can also generate electricity and provide everyday power for several county towns below.
Researchers want to use heat coming out of factories to generate electricity as well. If the experiment succeeds, stations and shopping centers could save a lot on electricity bills every year.

glosses.notes: Can mean starting a machine, launching an action, or mobilizing people to do something.

examples.sentence: 天还没亮，司机就在院子里发动卡车，准备把连夜赶出来的货先送到码头，再回厂里接下一批。
经理没有马上发动新的宣传活动，而是先让大家把上次失败的原因一条一条写清楚，再决定怎么改。
看到河水突然上涨以后，镇上的干部立刻发动镇里的人转移老人和孩子，免得天黑以后更危险。

example_translations.translation: Before daylight, the driver started the truck in the yard and got ready to send the goods finished overnight to the dock before coming back to pick up the next load.
The manager did not launch a new publicity campaign right away. Instead, he first had everyone write down the reasons for last time's failure one by one before deciding what to change.
After seeing the river rise suddenly, the town officials immediately mobilized people in the town to move the elderly and children so things would not become even more dangerous after dark.

glosses.notes: Used when money, goods, documents, or other materials are officially handed out.

examples.sentence: 开学那天，学校在操场上按班级发放新课本和本子，老师一边点名，一边提醒大家先数清楚。
公司决定把补贴直接发放到员工的银行卡里，这样外地出差的人也不用专门赶回来排队签字。
演出结束以后，主办方在门口发放问卷，希望观众把座位、灯光和声音的问题都写下来。

example_translations.translation: On the day school started, the school handed out new textbooks and notebooks by class on the playground while the teachers called names and reminded everyone to count everything carefully first.
The company decided to pay the subsidy directly into the employees' bank cards, so people on business trips away from home would not have to rush back just to line up and sign.
After the performance ended, the organizer distributed questionnaires at the entrance and hoped the audience would write down any problems with the seats, lighting, and sound.

glosses.notes: Used for something that gives off visible light, whether it glows softly or shines brightly.

examples.sentence: 停电以后，孩子发现书包上的小牌子还在发光，大家就借着那一点亮光先把楼道里的台阶看清楚。
这种材料白天吸收太阳光，晚上会慢慢发光，所以公园里的指示牌不用一直开着强灯也能看见。
医生把药水滴进伤口以后，屏幕上立刻有几个地方开始发光，说明那里还需要继续检查。

example_translations.translation: After the power went out, the child noticed that the little tag on the schoolbag was still glowing, so everyone used that bit of light to see the stairs in the hallway clearly first.
This material absorbs sunlight during the day and slowly gives off light at night, so the signs in the park can still be seen without keeping bright lamps on all the time.
After the doctor dripped the medicine onto the wound, several spots on the screen immediately lit up, showing that those areas still needed further examination.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to the official receipt issued for a purchase, payment, or reimbursement.

examples.sentence: 客人离开酒店的时候才发现自己把发票落在前台了，只好又给酒店打电话，请对方帮忙寄回来。
现在不少小店都能直接把电子发票发到邮箱里，出差的人一下车就可以把材料转给公司的财务。
她买完机器以后一直没走，因为合同和发票少一样，回去以后机器出了问题都不好办。

example_translations.translation: When the guest was leaving the hotel, he realized he had left the official receipt at the front desk, so he had to call the hotel again and ask them to mail it back.
Now many small shops can send an electronic receipt straight to your email, so people on business trips can forward the documents to the company finance office as soon as they get off the train.
After buying the machine, she still did not leave, because if either the contract or the official receipt was missing, any problem with the machine later would be hard to deal with.

glosses.notes: Most often means publishing or officially releasing something such as a book, album, or commemorative item.

examples.sentence: 这本书刚发行的时候只印了很少的数量，没想到读者的反应这么好，一个月以后出版社就决定加印。
报社准备下个月正式发行这份新杂志，所以最近每天都有不少人提前来问什么时候能买到第一期。
那位歌手的新歌还没发行，网上就已经有人先传开了，工作人员只好连夜查消息是从哪里出去的。

example_translations.translation: When this book was first published, only a small number of copies were printed. No one expected readers to respond so well, and a month later the publisher decided to print more.
The press is preparing to publish this new magazine next month, so lately quite a few people have been coming early every day to ask when they can buy the first issue.
The singer's new song had not been released yet when people online had already started passing it around, so the staff had to stay up overnight tracing where the news got out.

glosses.notes: Describes tissue or an injury becoming inflamed, often with pain, swelling, or heat.

examples.sentence: 他开始只觉得嗓子有点疼，没有太在意，结果连着几天开会又吹冷风，到了周末果然发炎了。
医生说他的牙齿已经发炎，如果再拖下去，半夜疼起来的时候不但睡不好，脸也可能一起肿起来。
孩子的伤口本来不大，可是游泳以后一直没有及时擦药，过了两天周围的皮肤就开始发炎。

example_translations.translation: At first he only felt that his throat hurt a little and did not pay much attention. After several straight days of meetings and cold wind, it really became inflamed by the weekend.
The doctor said his tooth was already inflamed. If he kept putting it off, not only would he be unable to sleep once it started hurting in the middle of the night, his face might swell too.
The child's wound was not big at first, but after swimming, no medicine was applied in time, and two days later the skin around it started to become inflamed.

glosses.notes: Used for physical or mental development as a person, animal, or plant grows.

examples.sentence: 医生看过检查结果以后说孩子的身体发育得不错，只要继续保持运动和睡眠，后面就没大问题了。
这种树在山里长得慢，可是根系发育得很深，所以碰到连续干旱的时候也不容易一下子死掉。
专家提醒家长，青春期除了身高和体重的变化，孩子心理的发育也需要被认真看见和耐心陪着。

example_translations.translation: After looking at the test results, the doctor said the child's physical development was good. As long as exercise and sleep were kept up, there should be no major problem later on.
This kind of tree grows slowly in the mountains, but its roots develop very deep, so even during a long dry spell it is not likely to die all at once.
The specialist reminded parents that during adolescence, besides changes in height and weight, a child's psychological development also needs to be noticed seriously and accompanied patiently.

glosses.notes: Describes something fixed by law, such as a procedure, holiday, or age requirement.

examples.sentence: 按照法定程序，公司改名之前不但要通知客户和员工，还得把相关材料送到几个部门去办。
这类岗位虽然工资看起来普通，可是只要合同写清楚，法定假日加班的费用一分也不能少。
法定退休年龄一调整，培训计划、保险安排和招聘时间表都得跟着改，不然人事部门很快就会乱起来。

example_translations.translation: According to the legally prescribed procedure, before changing its name, the company has to notify clients and employees and also send the relevant materials to several departments to get it processed.
These positions may not look impressive in salary terms, but as long as the contract is written clearly, not one bit of overtime pay for statutory holidays can be missing.

Once the legally prescribed retirement age is adjusted, training plans, insurance arrangements, and recruitment schedules all have to change with it, or the human resources department will quickly fall into confusion.

glosses.notes: Refers to the judge who hears a case and makes legal decisions in court.

examples.sentence: 快结束的时候，法官没有急着宣布结果，而是先把双方刚才争论的几个关键问题重新问了一遍。
那位年轻的法官说，处理家庭纠纷时最难的不是看材料，而是让情绪很重的双方愿意把话说完整。
新闻里提到，那位法官连续看了几天材料，最后才决定过一周再把双方叫来。

example_translations.translation: When things were almost over, the judge did not hurry to announce a result. Instead, he went back and asked both sides again about several key issues they had just argued over.
That young judge said that when handling family disputes, the hardest part is not reading the materials but getting both emotionally charged sides to tell the whole story.
The news report mentioned that the judge spent several days reading the materials before finally deciding to call both sides back a week later.

glosses.notes: Refers to formal laws and regulations that people, companies, or institutions must follow.

examples.sentence: 新法规一公布，做餐饮的老板们就忙着检查厨房、采购和垃圾处理，因为每一项都可能影响下个月的检查结果。
这家工厂以前总觉得排放问题离自己很远，后来真的因为违反法规被罚了钱，才开始认真改设备和流程。
做生意的人最怕没先弄清楚当地的法规，因为合同和税的要求常常完全不一样。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the new regulations were announced, restaurant owners got busy checking the kitchen, purchasing, and garbage handling, because any one of those items could affect next month's inspection result.
This factory used to feel that emission issues had little to do with it. Only after it was actually fined for violating regulations did it start seriously changing its equipment and procedures.
What businesspeople fear most is not understanding the local regulations first, because the requirements for contracts and taxes are often completely different.

glosses.primary_gloss: measure word for a round of
glosses.notes: This measure word often appears in phrases like 一番 or 几番 for a round of explanation, effort, thought, or discussion.

examples.sentence: 听完他这一番解释以后，原来最生气的几个人也慢慢安静下来，开始愿意坐下来继续把方案谈完。
她几番考虑以后还是决定辞职，不是因为工资太低，而是因为每天加班到深夜让家里一直没人照顾。
这场比赛结束以后，教练没有立刻批评队员，而是先做了一番总结，再把每个人的问题分别指出来。

example_translations.translation: After hearing that round of explanation from him, the people who had been the angriest gradually calmed down and became willing to sit down and finish discussing the plan.
After thinking it over several times, she still decided to resign, not because the pay was too low, but because the daily overtime until late at night meant no one was taking care of things at home.
After the match ended, the coach did not criticize the players right away. He first gave a round of summary comments and then pointed out each person's problem one by one.

glosses.notes: Describes a period, place, or schedule that is especially busy and full of tasks.

examples.sentence: 每到节日前最繁忙的那几天，仓库里从早到晚都有车进出，连负责统计的人都得站着把饭吃完。
这家医院平时已经很繁忙，一到流感高峰期，走廊里的加床和临时桌子常常一夜之间就全摆满了。
虽然她最近工作特别繁忙，但只要孩子学校有活动，她还是会提前把会开完，再赶过去坐在最后一排看完。

example_translations.translation: During the busiest few days before a holiday, vehicles go in and out of the warehouse from morning to night, and even the people doing the counting have to finish eating while standing.
This hospital is already very busy under normal conditions. Once flu season peaks, extra beds and temporary tables in the hallways are often filled overnight.
Although she has been especially busy at work lately, as long as her child's school has an event, she still finishes her meeting early and hurries over to sit in the last row and watch it through.

glosses.notes: Introduces a general rule meaning anyone or anything that fits the stated condition.

examples.sentence: 凡是要进实验室的人，都得先把手机和水放在门外，不然里面的仪器很容易被碰坏。
老师一再提醒，凡是自己没查过来源的消息，发到班级群之前都应该先停一下，别急着转给别人。
店长说，凡是今天买的大件商品，只要七天内没有使用痕迹，都可以拿着单子回来申请退换。

example_translations.translation: Anyone who needs to enter the lab must first leave their phone and water outside the door, or the instruments inside can easily be damaged.
The teacher kept reminding everyone that any message whose source they had not checked themselves should be paused before being posted to the class group instead of being forwarded in a hurry.
The store manager said that for any large item bought today, as long as there are no signs of use within seven days, people can bring the receipt back and apply for an exchange or return.

glosses.notes: Used for living things reproducing and increasing in number.

examples.sentence: 春天一到，湖里的鱼就开始繁殖，所以管理人员会提前提醒游客晚上不要走到水边。
科研人员发现这种鱼虽然繁殖得快，可是一旦水太冷，刚出生的小鱼还是很难活过第一周。
如果让外来的植物在山里大量繁殖，本地一些长得慢的树和花过几年就可能慢慢看不见了。

example_translations.translation: As soon as spring arrives, the fish in the lake begin to reproduce, so the staff remind visitors in advance not to walk to the water's edge at night.
Researchers found that this kind of fish breeds quickly, but once the water gets too cold, the newly born fish still have a hard time surviving the first week.
If outside plants are allowed to reproduce in large numbers in the mountains, some local trees and flowers that grow more slowly may gradually disappear within a few years.

glosses.notes: Most often means giving feedback or reporting back after using, seeing, or testing something.

examples.sentence: 系统刚上线那几天，客服把用户最常见的问题一条一条反馈给技术部门，大家晚上还在继续改程序和流程。
老师让大家看完短片以后马上反馈感受，因为他想知道哪些地方讲得太快，哪些地方还需要再举例。
这批机器送到工地以后，工人当天就反馈说开关太小，戴着手套时很难按准，设计组第二天就改了方案。

example_translations.translation: In the first few days after the system went online, customer service passed the users' most common problems back to the technical department one by one, and everyone was still revising the program and process at night.

The teacher asked everyone to give feedback on their reactions right after watching the short film, because he wanted to know which parts were explained too quickly and which parts still needed more examples.

After this batch of machines was delivered to the work site, the workers reported back that same day that the switch was too small and hard to press accurately with gloves on, so the design team changed the plan the next day.

glosses.notes: Means reflecting seriously on what happened, often to understand a mistake or rethink an approach.

examples.sentence: 项目停下来以后，负责人没有急着找借口，而是先带大家把每一步重新写下来，认真反思到底错在什么地方。
她回家路上一直在反思白天那场争论，后来才明白，问题不是对方太强硬，而是自己没把重点讲清楚。
每次考试结束，老师都会留半节课让学生反思最近的学习方法，这比只看分数更能看出哪里需要调整。

example_translations.translation: After the project came to a stop, the person in charge did not rush to make excuses. Instead, he first led everyone to write down every step again and seriously reflect on exactly where things had gone wrong.

On the way home, she kept rethinking the argument from earlier that day. Only later did she realize the problem was not that the other person had been too forceful, but that she herself had not explained the key point clearly.
After every exam, the teacher leaves half a class period for students to reflect on their recent study methods, because that shows where adjustments are needed better than just looking at the score.

glosses.notes: Usually goes with mistakes, rules, or laws to mean committing or violating something bad.

examples.sentence: 新来的会计并不是故意的，只是第一次接手这么复杂的表格，一紧张就连续犯了两个低级错误。
老板再着急也不敢犯法去卖假药，因为一旦真的出了事，不但赔不起，家里人也会一起受连累。
裁判提醒那位队员，如果再因为太生气而犯了错，不管比分多接近，最后也只能提前离场。

example_translations.translation: The new accountant did not do it on purpose. It was just his first time handling such a complicated set of forms, and once he got nervous he made two basic mistakes in a row.

No matter how anxious the boss was, he still did not dare break the law by selling fake medicine, because once something really went wrong, not only would he be unable to pay for it, his family would be dragged down too.
The referee warned that player that if he lost his temper again and made another mistake, then no matter how close the score was, he would still have to leave early.

glosses.notes: Refers to every aspect of a situation rather than only one side of it.

examples.sentence: 刚搬到一个新城市的时候，从找房子、办卡到认识新朋友，生活的方方面面都需要重新学一遍。
这次改革看上去只是改了几个表格，其实对招聘、培训和考核的方方面面都会慢慢产生影响。
她照顾老人以后才真正明白，医疗、交通和时间安排这些方方面面只要有一个环节出问题，整天的计划都会被打乱。

example_translations.translation: When you first move to a new city, every aspect of life has to be learned again, from finding a place to live and getting cards set up to making new friends.
This reform may look as if it only changed a few forms, but in fact it will gradually affect every aspect of recruitment, training, and evaluation.

Only after taking care of an elderly family member did she truly understand that in every aspect of medical care, transportation, and time planning, if one link goes wrong, the whole day's plan can be thrown off.

glosses.notes: Refers to direction or spatial orientation, especially when locating a place or judging where something faces.

examples.sentence: 山里的雾一起来，原来看得很清楚的路牌一下子就不见了，经验不多的人很容易连方位都判断错。
后来把几栋楼的方位重新调过以后，下午照进教室的太阳没有以前那么刺眼，学生坐久了也舒服不少。
夜里在海上开船时，大家最怕仪器忽然坏了，因为只要几分钟分不清方位，船就可能慢慢走错原来的路线。

example_translations.translation: Once the mountain fog rises, the road signs that were easy to see suddenly disappear, and people without much experience can easily misjudge even the direction they are facing.
After several buildings were reoriented later on, the afternoon sun shining into the classroom was not as harsh as before, and the students felt much more comfortable sitting there for a long time.

When sailing at sea at night, what people fear most is the instrument suddenly breaking, because if they lose their sense of direction for even a few minutes, the ship can slowly go off its original route.

glosses.notes: Refers to a regional variety of a language used in a particular place.

examples.sentence: 他刚到南方工作时，开会虽然都用普通话，可是同事一着急就会冒出方言，他常常得看表情才猜得到意思。
大家原来怕年轻观众听不懂那几句方言，后来发现正是这些真实的说法让整段故事更有那个地方的味道。
老人平时坚持跟孙子说一点家乡方言，不是怕普通话学不好，而是不想下一代完全听不懂家里的老话。

example_translations.translation: When he first went south to work, meetings were all held in standard Mandarin, but as soon as his coworkers got excited they would slip into dialect, and he often had to read their expressions to guess the meaning.

People were originally afraid younger viewers would not understand those few lines in dialect, but later realized that those authentic expressions were exactly what gave the whole story the flavor of that place.

The old man insists on speaking a little hometown dialect with his grandson, not because he fears the child will not learn standard Mandarin well, but because he does not want the next generation to be completely unable to understand the family's older speech.

glosses.notes: Means hindering something or getting in the way of normal progress.

examples.sentence: 他们修路的时候特意把机器往里放了一点，免得太靠近路边，妨碍路边的商店正常做生意。
她知道自己感冒还没好，所以开会时一直坐在后排少说话，怕咳嗽得太厉害会妨碍别人听报告。
研究人员解释说，光线太强不但会影响拍摄效果，有时候还会直接妨碍仪器判断样本表面的细小变化。

example_translations.translation: During the road work, they deliberately moved the machines slightly inward so they would not stay too close to the roadside and hinder the shops there from doing business normally.

She knew her cold was not over yet, so during the meeting she sat in the back and spoke as little as possible, afraid that coughing too badly would get in the way of other people listening to the report.
The researchers explained that overly strong light does more than affect the filming result. Sometimes it directly obstructs the instrument from judging the tiny changes on the surface of the sample.

glosses.notes: Refers to the price of housing or homes in a certain area.

examples.sentence: 这几年房价涨得太快，原来打算两年后再买房子的人，只好一边继续租地方住，一边重新算每个月能存多少。
城里新的地铁线一公布，周围几个小区的房价很快就有了变化，连原来不打算卖掉房子的人也开始打听价钱。
专家提醒大家，不要只因为别人说房价还会涨就急着签合同，先看看工作、贷款和家庭计划是不是都准备好了。

example_translations.translation: Housing prices have risen too fast in recent years, so people who had planned to buy a home two years later can only keep renting a place to live while recalculating how much they can save each month.

As soon as the new subway line in the city was announced, housing prices in several nearby compounds quickly changed, and even people who had not planned to sell their homes started asking about the prices.
Experts remind people not to rush into signing a contract just because someone says housing prices will keep rising. First they should check whether their job, loan, and family plans are all ready.

glosses.notes: Combines prevention with control, especially for disease, pests, or other spreading problems.

examples.sentence: 为了防治这种病在夏天大范围传播，社区提前安排了消毒、宣传和上门检查，希望把风险压得更低。
农业站每周都派人下乡讲防治地里虫子的方法，因为一旦错过最关键的几天，后面的损失往往会更大。
医院和学校最近开始一起合作做近视防治，不只教孩子少看屏幕，也提醒家长注意灯光和怎么坐。

example_translations.translation: To prevent and control this disease from spreading widely in summer, the community arranged disinfection, publicity, and door-to-door inspections in advance in hopes of pressing the risk lower.

The agricultural station sends people to the countryside every week to explain methods for preventing and controlling insects in the fields, because once the most critical few days are missed, the losses later are often much greater.

Recently the hospital and the school started working together on myopia prevention and control. They do more than teach children to look at screens less. They also remind parents to watch the lighting and how the child sits.

glosses.notes: Means conducting an interview or a focused question-and-answer conversation.

examples.sentence: 节目播出前，主持人又访谈了那位医生一次，怕前一版里关键原因讲得还不够清楚，观众听完还是抓不住重点。
记者为了访谈那位企业家准备了整整一周，不但看完对方以前的发言，还把最可能被回避的问题单独记在本子上。
老师让学生两个人一组去访谈社区里的老人，问问这些年生活有什么变化，回来以后再整理成报告。

example_translations.translation: Before the program aired, the host interviewed that doctor one more time because he worried that the key cause had still not been explained clearly enough in the earlier version and viewers would miss the point.

The reporter prepared for a full week in order to interview that entrepreneur. He not only read through the person's earlier remarks, but also wrote the questions most likely to be avoided separately in his notebook.
The teacher told the students to work in pairs to interview elderly people in the community, ask what changes they had seen in life over the years, and then organize it into a report afterward.
